raw.rationale: MLN-8054 is a potent Aurora A inhibitor whose single-agent cytotoxicity in 5-day PRISM assays is unlikely to be lineage-selective because Aurora A dependency is not confined to one lineage and resistance/sensitivity is largely driven by proliferation rate and efflux rather than lineage identity. Published PRISM/CTRP data for Aurora inhibitors show only weak, sporadic lineage enrichment, so probabilities are kept near the low base rate with modest increases for lineages where Aurora A or MYC-driven proliferation is more common.
